text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today's lunch is ankake udon.
Excitedly, I brought a spoonful to my mouth.
However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The freshly prepared thick-broth udon was hotter than expected! I nearly scalded my tongue...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Oh――

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Are you alright?
You seem to be in so much pain...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The cause is—ah, I see.
The disaster called 'heat,' was it?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Hehe, in that case, please rest assured.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I shall save you from misfortune.
With the power of this "Purification".

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It is a power capable of quelling all creation.
I will surely bring an end to this calamity.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: What could this "purifying power" possibly be...? Filled with curiosity, I waited to seeââ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (――*Slide*)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
In the name of the Saint, be cleansed――
Breath of Purification.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Phew, phew.
...Phew, phew, phew.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The calamity here has now been brought to an end.
All through the holy maiden's power of Purification.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The ankake udon had gone completely cold.
Though that was only natural, considering it had been blown cool through a bamboo shoot.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Somehow, the power of purification
turned out to be far more primitive than expected.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, whatever is the matter?
Could there perhaps be something else troubling you...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
In that case, by all means.
Please leave everything to Saint Red Desire.
choice_data_list: No, how should I put it…… That was incredible power.
Looks like you've been thoroughly purified.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I decided against adding
"in more ways than one"...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Fufu, ♪ We still have quite a way to go along this path, but――

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
With this power, I will one day ascend to "that place"â
to the otherworld. Without fail.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The steam had vanished from the udon, and having cooled down, the broth was losing its thickness...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
So it seems.
Fufu, I am relieved as well.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Should calamity ever strike again, please call upon me.
I shall come to your aid with the power of the Saintess whenever needed.
